title: Finite-field closed-support constructibility
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime, $k$ a field of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and $A$ a finite field of characteristic $\ell$. Let $g:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be a closed immersion of finite-type $k$-schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Use ordinary uncompleted derived categories of module sheaves over the constant ring sheaf $A_T$ on small pro-étale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $\mathcal B_A(T)$ for the complexes whose cohomology vanishes outside a finite interval and is constructible [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf]: there is a finite constructible locally closed stratification on which each cohomology sheaf is pro-étale locally constant with finite-dimensional $A$-module values. Let $Rg^!$ be the ambient right adjoint to exact closed direct image [lem-exc-proetale-closed-support]. Then $Rg^!\mathcal B_A(T)\subseteq\mathcal B_A(Z)$. No global cohomological-dimension bound on $k$ is assumed.

proof.text: Let U be the open subscheme with underlying set complementary to the image of g, and j its inclusion. Local finite type over Spec k makes T locally Noetherian, and quasi-compactness of its structure map makes it compact. Thus T is Noetherian and j is quasi-compact. The images of g and j are complementary.

proof.text: For any scheme X and finite ring A, the intrinsic realization equivalence identifies the fixed-module bounded-constructible predicate of etale origin with finite intrinsic cohomological support and constructible intrinsic homology. Convert finite support to vanishing outside a closed integer interval (choose min and max of bounding integers, including the empty-support case). The finite-ring constructible-derived-origin theorem identifies this intrinsic condition with the essential image of bounded constructible etale complexes. Convert the two etale bounded-constructible predicates by the etale sheaf constructibility comparison and the standard derived t-structure. Factor the derived comparison as fixed-coefficient comparison followed by realization and cancel the fully faithful realization. This proves the equivalence in both directions.

proof.text: The adjoint constant-ring map for g identifies sfConstantModuleDirectImage with proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage: unfold the two definitions and apply proEtaleConstantModulePullback_ring_direct. The canonical sfIntrinsicDerivedDirectImageComparison then identifies realization followed by intrinsic derived direct image with fixed-module derived direct image followed by realization. Compose the intrinsic closed ambient adjunction and the fixed-module closed ambient adjunction with the realization adjunctions. Uniqueness of right adjoints produces an isomorphism from intrinsic exceptional inverse image followed by inverse realization to inverse realization followed by fixed-module exceptional inverse image.

Its proof is the source support-triangle proof: the open direct image of the open pullback is bounded constructible; triangulated closure gives constructibility of the closed-support term; exact closed direct image and the closed counit identify its closed pullback with the exceptional inverse image. Specialize its finite ring to ULift A and its annihilator to ell. The scalar ell vanishes in ULift A by its characteristic, and is nonzero in k since ell is prime and p differs from ell. The target structure morphism supplies exactly its finite-type hypotheses. This is reuse of the existing fixed-module proof of the present mathematical node, followed by the explicit coefficient and adjoint comparisons, not an additional unproved intermediate statement.

proof.text: Use the equivalence of bounded-constructible predicates from step 2 on inverse realization of K, apply step 4, and transport back along the isomorphism of exceptional inverse images from step 3 and the realization counits. The intrinsic bounded-constructible property is invariant under isomorphisms by the existing triangulated-subcategory theorem. This proves exactly the stated ordinary intrinsic exceptional inverse-image conclusion. No separatedness, nonemptiness or absolute cohomological-dimension bound is required.
